sample_unit: Emergency Internal Medicine reports (de-identified, with inserted or confirmed errors)
unlisted_practices: Using LLMs (including locally deployable open-source models) as AI second reviewers to detect errors in clinician-authored clinical reports
Choosing open-source over closed-source LLMs for privacy-preserving, customizable local deployment

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the performance of three LLMs (open vs closed source) acting as second reviewers to detect synthetic/confirmed clinical errors in 102 real-world internal medicine reports compared to human reviewers, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard variation.
